name: std::multimap<Key,T,Compare,Allocator>::emplace
intro:
Inserts a new element into the container constructed in-place with the given args.

The constructor of the new element (i.e. std::pair<const Key, T>) is called with exactly the same arguments as supplied to emplace, forwarded via std::forward<Args>(args)....

Careful use of emplace allows the new element to be constructed while avoiding unnecessary copy or move operations.

No iterators or references are invalidated.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
args

 -

 arguments to forward to the constructor of the element

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: An iterator to the inserted element.

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.text: If an exception is thrown for any reason, this function has no effect (strong exception safety guarantee).

sections.title: Complexity
sections.text: Logarithmic in the size of the container.

a => a
b => abcd
